name: Mythos Gates Faction Visual Bible
purpose: Canonical appearance, armor, material, symbol, and rejection guidance for all seven playable factions so prompts and creator handoffs generate detailed, faction-specific art.
globalRules: Faction identity must be visible through materials, silhouette, symbols, texture, and posture before any generic fantasy trope.
deities are living extradimensional beings, not buildings, robots, statues, block stacks, or abstract architecture piles.
NPCs are non-playable lore characters whose costume must show role, faction duty, and personal history.
Creatures can be monstrous but must stay rooted in faction or Hollow logic rather than generic alien design.
Architecture can influence clothing, regalia, auras, weapons, and environment — never replace living anatomy for character assets.
No readable real-world text or logos; glyphs and marks must be abstract lore texture.

entries.visualThesis: Aten Ra is the source behind human Egyptian solar myth: living Ma’at, Ra’s noon authority, Aten’s sun-disc radiance, Khepri’s renewal, Iset’s throne-magic, Sutekh’s necessary desert violence, Maahes’ lion protection, and Amunet’s hidden power. Designs must feel like ancient humans copied these beings later — not like Deities copied Egypt.
bodyAnatomyRules: Bodies use strong readable anatomy with elongated divine proportions, royal stillness, ceremonial hand language, and gravity like the noon sun holding the world in place.
Skin, energy, linen wrap, collar, crown, and pectoral can fuse into one living office of divine law, but head, torso, limbs, gesture, expression, and faction role must stay legible.

Animal divinity must come from Egyptian source functions: falcon-solar sight, cobra protection, jackal threshold guidance, scarab renewal, lion war-guardianship, ibis/scribe precision, or crocodile/river menace — never random hybrid clutter.
Use Nile/Red Land dual anatomy: black fertile stone or river-glass surfaces balanced against desert-red scars, storm-sand erosion, and white-gold solar seams.
armorShapeLanguage: solar-disc crown or aura with subtle hand-ray geometry inspired by Aten, not sci-fi rings
broad wesekh-style divine collar and pectoral plates fused to chest anatomy

Ma’at feather balance lines across armor seams, never readable text

faience-like blue-green glaze, lapis chips, obsidian enamel cracks lit from within

armorConstructionRules: Armor is divine office made physical: crown, collar, pectoral, linen, scale, pylon harness, and sacred weapon geometry bonded to living extradimensional anatomy.
Human Egyptian crowns, ankhs, pylons, collars, and temple forms are in-world human copies of these Aten Ra originals; the deity version should feel older, stranger, and more functional.
Pylons, obelisks, shrines, and solar courts can influence silhouettes as shoulder frames, auras, gates, collars, shields, or weapons — never as building torsos or city-on-body decoration.
Every armor choice must reveal myth function: Ma’at law, Ra kingship, Aten radiance, Khepri renewal, Sutekh storm-disruption, Iset restoration, Maahes guarding, or Amunet concealment.
deityRules: Deities read as colossal offices of cosmic law: Ra’s sovereign noon, Aten’s direct radiance, Khepri’s rebirth engine, Ma’at’s balance, Sutekh’s dangerous defense, Iset’s restoration, Maahes’ lion guard, or Amunet’s hidden execution.
Silhouettes should use divine regalia more than generic plate: collars, crowns, nemes-flow, pectorals, scarabs, scale forms, barque arcs, threshold masks, and pylon harnesses.
No city-on-body, no temple-on-legs, no block pyramids, no robot sarcophagus chassis, no tourist-costume pharaoh helmet.
Each deity should imply which human deity or symbol humans later remembered incorrectly.
npcRules: NPCs wear lived-in priest-scribe, gate-judge, embalmer-architect, river astronomer, court official, or solar engineer regalia with linen folds, wax seals, faience beads, bronze tools, ink palettes, and obsidian tablets.
Faces should carry duty, fatigue, scholarship, fear of judgment, or devotion to Ma’at — not superhero confidence.
Use sun-baked fabric folds, worn sandals, ritual collars, reed pens, palettes, measuring cords, star charts, and duty-worn ceremonial seals to show service inside the Realm.
NPC clothing must look like the practical source of later human priestly/royal costume, not a replica of museum clothing.
creatureRules: Aten creatures should look like divine law turned predatory: solar brands, judgement masks, desert-scorched hide, obsidian enamel wounds, and punishment anatomy that could only come from the Solar Dominion of Khepra.
Punishment anatomy should include scorched Ma’at-feather brands, radiant scars, jackal/cobra/lion threshold masks, or scarab renewal growths tied to a specific Aten rite.
Set-aligned beasts may be storm-red desert guardians rather than pure villains, while Isfet-corrupted variants twist order into violence and broken symmetry.
Creatures must remain mythic animals/law-spirits/punishment constructs grown from divine force, not robots or generic undead mummies.
environmentRules: The realm is built around Nile/Red Land duality: black fertile river-memory channels, lotus/papyrus courts, sun-white limestone terraces, and red desert storm bastions held together by Ma’at geometry.

Architecture uses pylons, open sun courts, obelisks, barque canals, necropolis horizons, measuring halls, throne sanctums, faience pools, and shadow archives — but characters must not become architecture.
Lighting should create readable sacred hierarchy: horizon, sun-disc, throne, judgment scale, river channel, archive seal, battlefield danger.
Humans later copied these forms as temples, crowns, tombs, and funerary art; the realm version should be larger, stranger, alive, and directly functional.
avoid: mummy wrap monster unless explicitly Hollow-corrupted
random animal mashup without myth function

entries.factionSkinLock: FACTION DIVINE SKIN — ATEN RA SOLAR LAW ANATOMY: The deity's skin IS solar law made flesh. Electrum-white base that radiates warm light from within — not painted gold, not metallic, but living divine illumination held in skin cells. Black Nile silt glass shadow-planes on the shaded side of every limb — the duality of noon light and Nile dark, Ma'at balance expressed in the body itself. Red desert jasper fault-lines as natural scar patterns where chaotic power has been judged and contained. Faience turquoise and lapis inlays are GROWN INTO the skin like living divine circuitry — each inlay marks a law the deity embodies, not decoration. The skin texture is smooth divine ceramic-glass, NOT human skin texture — it looks like polished faience come to life. Solar cracks of amber light trace where old wounds healed into stronger law. The body radiates a faint corona of solar warmth — not a halo, but heat-shimmer of divine authority. The SKIN ITSELF communicates: 'I am the law that the sun enforces. My body is the balance that Ma'at demands.' Every visible surface shows the duality of solar order (gold light) and contained chaos (jasper fault-lines).
entries.factionGroundEffects: FACTION GROUND EFFECTS — ATEN RA SOLAR LAW EARTH: The ground beneath Aten Ra deities is solar law made earth. Geometric Ma'at balance lines radiate outward in electrum-gold from the deity's feet — perfect symmetry, not random cracks, because Ma'at IS balance. Scarab-shaped energy patterns glow in turquoise faience in the ground — each scarab is a renewal cycle made visible. Aten hand-rays crack outward from beneath the deity in white-gold, the same hand-rays that ancient Egyptians drew in tomb art, but here they are REAL and they are in the EARTH. The ground surface looks like sacred pylon-gate flagstones with lapis inlay channels — not dirt, not generic stone, but temple floor that exists because the deity's law demands structure. Desert sand particles rise in solar radiance around the deity's feet. The ground communicates: 'This earth is ordered because I AM order. Chaos bends to law where I stand.' Nile-black and desert-red duality visible in every crack — the dual nature of Egyptian divine authority.
entries.factionBackground: Aten Ra background: colossal pylon gates and temple columns towering behind the deity at massive scale — the deity stands before architecture that makes ancient temples look small. White-gold solar radiance flooding from above with Aten hand-ray patterns visible in the light. Obsidian-blue shadows contrasting with the gold. Papyrus circuitry and Ma'at feather geometry floating in the air as sacred law made visible. The background should communicate: this is a SOLAR LAW KING standing in their DOMAIN — divine authority, sacred order, and the weight of judgment. Scale reference: the deity should appear to tower over the architecture, not the other way around.
entries.skinLanguage: Electrum-white radiance skin with Nile-black glass shadow planes and red desert jasper fault lines. Faience turquoise and lapis inlays run through the skin like divine circuitry. White-gold solar seams glow at armor joints. The skin itself radiates faint solar warmth — not painted gold, but living solar law made flesh. Solar cracks of amber light where wounds have healed. Scarab-emerald pulse points at chest, forearms, and temples.
entries.traitDetails: Elongated divine proportions — longer limbs, taller frame than any human. Royal stillness in every gesture. Ceremonial hand language frozen mid-ritual. Eyes glow with Aten hand-ray geometry. The body radiates a faint corona of solar law — not a halo, but heat-shimmer of divine authority.
entries.factionIdeology: Solar Dominion — divine law, Ma'at balance, pharaonic authority, the sun as ultimate order

entries.factionSkinLock: FACTION DIVINE SKIN — ASGARDIAN OATH-STORM ANATOMY: The deity's skin IS oath made flesh. Storm-iron base — not metal armor, but divine skin that has been forged by centuries of oath-keeping. Rune-wound scars are burned DIRECTLY INTO the skin as physical marks — not tattoos, not paint, not glow effects, but actual burned wounds where oaths have been carved into the deity's body. Each scar is a vow kept or a price paid. Ash-root veins run BENEATH the surface like living Yggdrasil roots growing through divine flesh — the world-tree remembers every oath and records it in the deity's body. Raven-feather shadow patches darken the skin in places where Valkyrie death-law has marked the deity — permanent storm-stains that can never be removed. Wolf-pelt weathering texture roughens the forearms and shoulders — divine skin weathered by surviving impossible cold and storm, proof of endurance. Blackwinter frost cracks trace across exposed areas as white-ice damage lines. The skin texture is rough, weathered, storm-scarred — NOT smooth, NOT human. The SKIN ITSELF communicates: 'Every scar is an oath I kept. Every storm-stain is a warrior I chose. My body is the record of promises that outlast worlds.' Runes glow faintly in their scars when oath-power is active — the old promises speaking through flesh.
entries.factionGroundEffects: FACTION GROUND EFFECTS — ASGARDIAN OATH-STORM EARTH: The ground beneath Asgardian deities is oath-storm made earth. Storm-iron cracks split the earth in jagged oath-wound patterns — not geometric, not clean, but violent like lightning, because oaths are not gentle. Funeral ember glow bleeds from each fissure — the funeral pyres of warriors chosen by the deity, their fire still burning in the earth. Oath-red wax pools in the cracks like sacred blood — each pool is a promise made physical. Raven-feather shadow wisps spread outward across the ground, the shadows of Valkyrie wings that touched this earth. Blackwinter frost crystallizes at the edges in white-blue ice patterns — the cold of the void that oaths hold back. World-root veins spread from the deity's feet like living roots — Yggdrasil's memory growing through the ground. The ground surface looks like a shattered storm-bridge or rune-mountain hall floor — broken flagstones with rune-wounds, NOT generic ground. The ground communicates: 'This earth is cracked by oaths and healed by storm. Every fissure is a promise. Every fire is a warrior I called home.'
entries.factionBackground: Asgardian background: colossal storm-bridge arches and rune-carved mountain halls towering behind the deity at massive scale. Blue-white lightning splitting the sky. World-root veins growing through the architecture like living veins. Raven omen flocks circling in the storm-light above. Wolf banners and shield-wall geometry visible on the ruins. Funeral flame braziers burning at colossal scale. The background should communicate: this is a STORM-OATH DEITY standing in their DOMAIN — ancient power, oath-bound authority, and the weight of storms. Scale reference: the deity should tower over the architecture, making Viking longhalls look like children's toys.
entries.skinLanguage: Storm-iron skin with rune-wound scars burned directly into flesh — not painted, not tattooed, but carved by oath and lightning. Ash-root veins pulse beneath the surface like living world-root. Raven-feather shadow patches darken the skin like permanent storm stains. Blackwinter frost cracks trace across exposed areas. Wolf-pelt weather texture on forearms and shoulders — rough, wind-carved, surviving impossible cold.
entries.traitDetails: Broad heavy divine frame — wider shoulders, thicker bone structure than any human. Runes glow faintly in their scars when oath-power is active. Storm-lightning flickers across the skin in moments of power. The body carries the weight of ancient promises — every scar is a vow kept or broken. Breath visible as frost-ember mist.
entries.factionIdeology: Storm-oath — oaths carved in flesh, storms as the voice of promises kept, world-root as the living record of every vow

entries.factionSkinLock: FACTION DIVINE SKIN — OLYMPIAN CIVIC GLORY ANATOMY: The deity's skin IS competitive excellence made flesh. Living marble-light base — the skin appears to be luminous white-veined marble, but it is WARM and it BREATHES. This is not stone; this is divine flesh that looks like marble because excellence carves itself into the body. Bronze circuit-lines run through the marble like living laurel veins — each bronze line is a contest won, a trial passed, a victory earned. The bronze grows from the skin naturally, the way laurels grow from a champion's brow. Oracle smoke wisps rise from the skin surface — the deity's presence causes the air itself to prophesy. Gold-blue skyfire flickers in the eyes and divine markings — the fire of Zeus's forge, the light of civic ambition. The skin texture is smooth, luminous, marble-veined with bronze inlay — NOT human skin, NOT cold stone, but living marble that radiates the warmth of ambrosia. The SKIN ITSELF communicates: 'I am what excellence looks like when it becomes a body. Every bronze vein is a trial I mastered. The marble is proof that I was tested and I won.' The body radiates a victory aura of gold-blue light — standing in their presence feels like being watched by a stadium.
entries.factionGroundEffects: FACTION GROUND EFFECTS — OLYMPIAN CIVIC TRIAL EARTH: The ground beneath Olympian deities is civic trial made earth. Marble amphitheater floor cracking in geometric patterns — not random, but precise, because competition demands structure. Bronze lightning patterns strike outward from the deity's feet — the same bronze that veins their skin, now striking the earth. Laurel-leaf shapes in ambrosia gold radiate outward from where the deity stands — each leaf is a victory made ground. Eagle-shadow energy sweeps across the ground surface — the shadow of Zeus's eagle passing over, marking this ground as contested. Oracle smoke wisps rise from ground fissures — the earth itself prophesies the outcome of whatever trial the deity commands. Gold-blue skyfire burns in the cracks. The ground surface looks like a divine arena floor — carved marble with laurel circuits and bronze inlay channels, NOT generic stone. The ground communicates: 'This earth is where trials happen. Every crack is a contest. Every laurel is a victory I awarded. Stand here and be measured.'
entries.factionBackground: Olympian background: colossal amphitheater columns and marble courts towering behind the deity at massive scale. Violet heavens with gold-blue skyfire. Laurel circuits glowing on the architecture. Living statues of past champions flanking the deity at smaller scale. Bronze weapons embedded in marble walls as trophies. The background should communicate: this is an OLYMPIAN DEITY standing in their DOMAIN — civic power, competitive glory, and the weight of divine politics. Scale reference: the deity should tower over the architecture, making Greek temples look small.
entries.skinLanguage: Living marble-light skin — not stone, but luminous semi-translucent divine flesh that glows from within. entries.factionSkinLock: FACTION DIVINE SKIN — KAMI SACRED THRESHOLD ANATOMY: The deity's skin IS the threshold between spirit and matter made flesh. Lacquer-smooth divine skin with a subtle shrine-glow beneath the surface — the skin itself glows like the inside of a sacred lantern. Torii-red lacquer patterns mark the skin as sacred body-paint that is actually PART OF the divine body — each torii-red mark is a threshold the deity embodies, a gate between worlds worn as skin. Foxfire-blue energy pulses beneath the skin in veins — not blood, but spiritual energy, the fire of the kami that burns in the space between material and spirit. Mirror-silver reflective patches appear on the skin like living divine mirrors — these are points where the deity reflects the world back at itself, purification by reflection. Paper-white shide marks on the skin are sacred purification lines — the same paper streamers that hang at shrines, but here they are grown into the body. The skin texture is smooth, lacquered, slightly reflective — NOT human skin, but divine surface that exists at a threshold. Parts of the body blur slightly at the edges like ink in water — the deity is not fully material, not fully spirit, but the GATE between them. The SKIN ITSELF communicates: 'I am the gate. My body is the threshold you cross. My skin is the paper you write your prayer on and the mirror that shows your truth.'
entries.factionGroundEffects: FACTION GROUND EFFECTS — KAMI SACRED THRESHOLD EARTH: The ground beneath Kami deities is sacred threshold made earth. Torii-red light radiates outward in sacred threshold patterns — each radiating line is a gate boundary, the edge of sacred space expanding from the deity's feet. Foxfire-blue pools and wisps spread across the ground — spiritual energy made visible in the earth, the fire between worlds burning in the soil. Cherry blossom energy petals fall and dissolve into light on the ground — each petal is a moment of impermanence, the kami's domain over the cycle of bloom and fall. Moon-silver crescent patterns glow on the ground surface — the moon's authority reflecting in the earth. Paper-white shadow patterns from unseen shide streamers fall across the ground — purification marks that cleanse the earth by their presence. Lacquered-black ground cracks with spiritual energy. The ground surface looks like a shrine-path or sacred courtyard — lacquered wood flooring with torii-gate shadows, NOT generic ground. The ground communicates: 'This earth is sacred because I stand on it. Every foxfire pool is a gate. Every petal is a prayer answered. Step within my threshold and be purified.'
entries.factionBackground: Kami background: colossal torii gates and shrine architecture towering behind the deity at massive scale. Sacred cherry blossom trees in full bloom at enormous scale. Moon bridges arching through mist. Foxfire-blue spirit lanterns floating in the air. Shimenawa sacred cords hanging at divine scale. Mirror discs reflecting different aspects of the realm. The background should communicate: this is a KAMI DEITY standing in their DOMAIN — sacred threshold, spiritual authority, and the weight of nature-divine power. Scale reference: the deity should tower over the shrine architecture.
entries.skinLanguage: Lacquered divine skin with torii-red undertones and foxfire-blue pulse lines. Mirror-silver highlights catch light on cheekbones and shoulders like living polished metal. Shimenawa cord patterns are grown into the skin as sacred threshold marks. Cedar-bark texture on forearms. Cherry blossom energy blooms at wound sites. The skin shifts between solid and spirit — edges blur slightly like ink in water.
entries.traitDetails: Graceful divine proportions — elongated, flowing, with supernatural balance. Mask-like quality to facial features — not rigid, but sacred. The body exists at a threshold between material and spirit — at will, parts become smoke, light, or petal. Foxfire-blue wisps trail from fingertips and hair. Seasonal energy radiates from the skin.
entries.factionIdeology: Sacred threshold — the boundary between spirit and matter, purification as authority, shrine as the physical anchor of divine presence

deityRules: Deities read as colossal myth offices of The Infernal Dominion, with anatomy and armor fused by function.
Each deity should imply which human deity, spirit, monster, rite, or symbol humans later remembered incorrectly.
Avoid robot, mech, statue, mascot, and costume readings.
Preserve mobile-readable role silhouette.
npcRules: NPCs should look like people who maintain The Infernal Dominion as living civilization: witnesses, envoys, scribes, priests, judges, brokers, scouts, cartographers, or keepers.
Their clothing and tools are practical source-culture artifacts later copied by humans.
Faces carry duty, fear, pride, devotion, fatigue, or cunning — not generic hero posing.
Use worn regalia and task tools to show social role.
creatureRules: Creatures are realm law made animal, punishment, omen, guardian, or corruption, specific to Infernal Dominion.
Monster anatomy must reference a myth function from the anchors.
Hollow-corrupted variants twist that faction’s order into broken asymmetry.
Avoid generic alien beasts.
environmentRules: Environments must show The Infernal Dominion as the source behind human mythic spaces, not a themed set.
Landmarks, weather, hazards, and sacred architecture physically shape movement.
Terrain danger must be embedded in culture and myth: no game-board glow or arbitrary colored tiles.
Humans later copied these places as temples, halls, shrines, courts, stories, and monster geographies.

entries.factionSkinLock: FACTION DIVINE SKIN — INFERNAL CONTRACT POWER ANATOMY: The deity's skin IS contract made flesh. Volcanic-glass base — obsidian-black surface with hellfire glowing BENEATH. The skin is not stone, not glass, not flesh — it is divine matter forged in infernal heat, and the heat is still visible inside. Blood-wax red veins run through the obsidian like molten cracks — each vein is a contract clause made visible in the body. The Infernal Dominion believes that all power is transactional, and the body proves it: every vein is a deal, every crack is a debt. Brass-scorched patterns mark where power has burned through the skin — these are the marks of deals that went wrong, or deals that went RIGHT with terrible cost. Contract-parchment texture appears on some skin areas — the actual text of ancient contracts fused into the skin as texture (but NOT readable text — abstract parchment texture only). Ash-velvet darkness gathers at the edges of the body — shadows pool unnaturally because the Infernal Dominion exists where light goes to die. Chain-link scars are branded into the flesh as living debt-marks — the chains of the hierarchy, the proof that even gods can owe. The SKIN ITSELF communicates: 'Every vein is a contract. Every crack is a price paid. My body is the ledger of every deal that shaped this realm. I am the forge where power is bought and sold.'
entries.factionGroundEffects: FACTION GROUND EFFECTS — INFERNAL CONTRACT POWER EARTH: The ground beneath Infernal Dominion deities is contract power made earth. Volcanic-glass cracks split the ground in jagged obsidian patterns — not geometric like Empyrean, not balanced like Aten Ra, but sharp and aggressive, because contracts CUT. Hellfire bleeds from each fissure — the heat of the forge, the fire of unpaid debts. Blood-wax pools in the cracks like molten contracts — each pool is a deal made physical in the earth. Obsidian shatter patterns radiate outward — the glass of broken promises, the shards of deals that collapsed. Infernal heat distortion ripples the air above the ground in black and red — the forge-fire of the Dominion. Black-iron star-patterns mark the ground — the brands of the hierarchy, stamped into the earth. Chain-link shadow patterns spread from the deity's feet — the shadows of contracts binding the very ground. The ground surface looks like a volcanic throne-room floor — obsidian and black iron, NOT generic ground. The ground communicates: 'This earth is bound by contract. Every crack is a deal. Every fire is a debt being collected. Step here and you owe — the ground itself is the ledger.'
entries.factionBackground: Infernal Dominion background: colossal volcanic throne architecture and obsidian courts towering behind the deity at massive scale. Hellfire rivers flowing in the distance. Chain-link architecture forming the walls. Grimoire-seal patterns glowing on the obsidian. Brass-forged gates at divine scale. Ash-velvet sky with ember-storm. The background should communicate: this is an INFERNAL DEITY standing in their DOMAIN — contract power, infernal authority, and the weight of hellish sovereignty. Scale reference: the deity should tower over the infernal architecture.
entries.skinLanguage: Volcanic-glass divine skin with obsidian-black surface and hellfire-glow cracks beneath. Blood-wax veins pulse red beneath the dark surface like contract clauses made visible. Brass-scorched patterns mark where power has burned through. Ash-velvet texture on shoulders and neck. Chain-link scars are branded into the flesh as living debt-marks. The skin radiates infernal heat — standing near it feels like standing near a forge.
entries.traitDetails: Dominant divine proportions — imposing, heavy, with the weight of sovereignty and debt. Horn growths from brow and shoulders are part of the skull, not worn. Star-crack patterns radiate from old wounds. The body smells of ash and brass and old contracts. Hellfire flickers in the cracks when power surges. Shadows pool unnaturally around the feet.
entries.factionIdeology: Contract power — debt as sovereignty, chains as law, volcanic heat as the forge of infernal authority
